projects.name: Verdis-Go: Redis-Compatible In-Memory Data Store
projects.summary: Golang implementation of a Redis-compatible in-memory data store using the RESP protocol.
projects.description: Engineered a Redis-compatible in-memory data store in Go from scratch, implementing the RESP protocol and 25+ commands across strings, lists, hashes, and sets, sustaining 79K req/s (GET) and 77K req/s (SET) at sub-millisecond p99 latency.
features: Goroutine-per-client concurrency model with sharded locking
AOF command logging, RDB snapshotting, and replication backlog
projects.notes: Verified through live crash-recovery testing and replication behavior analysis.

projects.name: CipherChat
projects.summary: Real-time encrypted client-server chat platform with secure room-based communication.
projects.description: Built a real-time encrypted client-server chat platform in C++17 supporting secure multi-room communication over TCP. Implemented X25519 key exchange, HKDF-SHA256 key derivation, and AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption with AAD-bound per-room and per-session keys.
features: X25519 key exchange and HKDF-SHA256 derivation
Multithreaded server with room management and encrypted history replay
projects.notes: Built with a custom binary framing protocol over TCP.

projects.name: Pesky Birds
projects.summary: 2D physics-based Angry Birds clone built in Java with LibGDX and Box2D.
projects.description: Developed a 2D physics-based Angry Birds clone using LibGDX and Box2D, featuring slingshot-driven projectile mechanics and collision-based destructible environments. Built multiple levels with progression, scoring, win/lose conditions, pause/resume, and a level-selector system.
features: Slingshot projectile mechanics and destructible environments
Level progression, scoring, and win/lose logic
Modular OOP design using inheritance, polymorphism, abstraction, and encapsulation
projects.notes: Built as a modular game architecture with reusable game entities and render hooks.
